text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station noon news report on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The president's office confirmed a meeting of the three Baltic presidents with Ukraine President Leonid Kuchma in Tallinn in May to talk about regional co-operation and European security. The annual meeting of the three presidents of Baltic countries is scheduled on May 27.
- World Bank and IMF experts start a two-week working visit to Lithuania.
- The chairman of the Italian Senate Nicola Manchino is to arrive in Vilnius.
